scope: SDD SPEC synthesis for capture-decoupling-r5: migrate DD Chain Explorer capture layer from AWS managed services to Hostinger VPS + Confluent Platform 7.6.x + Redis

findings.title: 3 S3 Sink Connectors required (not 2)
findings.detail_md: The data-architect v2 report specified only 2 Kafka Connect S3 Sink Connectors (blocks + decoded txs). The data-engineer v2 report confirmed that `b_ethereum.eth_transactions` Bronze table reads from `raw/mainnet-transactions-data/`, requiring a third connector. The SPEC mandates 3 connectors: `s3-sink-blocks`, `s3-sink-txs-data`, `s3-sink-txs-decoded`.
findings.fix_recommendation: Implement all 3 S3 Sink Connector configs in `infra/kafka-connect/connectors/`. The third connector reads topic `mainnet-transactions-data` with consumer group `connect-s3-sink-txs-data`.

findings.title: dm-app-logs Bronze UDF incompatible with Fluent Bit NDJSON
findings.detail_md: The grill-me session (ADR-CAPTURE-005 original) concluded dm-app-logs was unchanged. The data-engineer v2 report (F-007) found that Bronze `b_app_logs_data` uses `cloudFiles.format=binaryFile` with a CloudWatch envelope UDF (`_extract_cw_log_events`) expecting double-gzip format. Fluent Bit writes plain NDJSON. After VPS cutover, `b_app_logs_data` will fail silently, breaking `g_api_keys.*` Gold MVs. The SPEC supersedes the grill-me conclusion: the fix is a hard dependency (Section 2.8, Section 7.2).
findings.fix_recommendation: In `dd-chain-explorer` DABs `dlt_app_logs`: remove `_extract_cw_log_events` UDF, switch to `cloudFiles.format=json`. Deploy to DEV before SC-09 gate. Validate Silver and Gold row counts.

findings.title: S3 Sink Connector path config must use topics.dir=raw + TimeBasedPartitioner
findings.detail_md: Kafka Connect S3 Sink default path is `topics/<topic>/partition=P/`. Databricks Auto Loader expects `raw/<stream>/year=Y/month=M/day=D/hour=H/`. The data-engineer v2 report (F-001 CRITICAL) specifies mandatory connector config override. The devops-engineer v2 report's connector-init script incorrectly uses `AvroFormat` instead of `JsonFormat` — corrected in SPEC ADR-CAPTURE-008.
findings.fix_recommendation: All 3 connector JSON configs must include: `topics.dir=raw`, `partitioner.class=io.confluent.connect.storage.partitioner.TimeBasedPartitioner`, `path.format='year'=YYYY/'month'=MM/'day'=dd/'hour'=HH`, `timestamp.extractor=Record`, `format.class=io.confluent.connect.s3.format.json.JsonFormat`, `value.converter.schemas.enable=false`.

findings.title: Schema Registry must be FULL compatibility (not BACKWARD)
findings.detail_md: Both data-architect v2 and software-architect v2 reports recommended BACKWARD compatibility. The data-engineer v2 report (F-003) identified that field removal under BACKWARD-only mode would silently drop all rows from DLT Silver `expect_or_drop` expectations. FULL compatibility (bidirectional) is required.
findings.fix_recommendation: Set `PUT /config {"compatibility": "FULL"}` on first Schema Registry deployment. Include as SC-14 validation gate.

findings.title: TransactionDecoded.avsc must include block_timestamp field
findings.detail_md: The software-architect v2 report warned that `TransactionDecoded.avsc` must include `block_timestamp` for correct S3 hourly partitioning. This field is required for connector `timestamp.extractor=Record` and forward compatibility if `RecordField` extractor is used in future.
findings.fix_recommendation: Add `block_timestamp` as a required field in `TransactionDecoded.avsc` before any schema registration. Validated via schema inspection (SC-02) before first production deployment.

findings.title: Control Center must be replaced with Kafka UI before PROD go-live
findings.detail_md: `cp-enterprise-control-center` has a 30-day trial license. It must not be used in long-term PROD. Kafka UI (Provectus, MIT, ~100 MB RAM) is the replacement. TASKS.md must include this as a mandatory item before PROD cutover.
findings.fix_recommendation: Swap `cp-enterprise-control-center` for `provectuslabs/kafka-ui:latest` in `docker-compose.yml` before PROD deployment. SC-13 is the validation gate.

findings.title: CA private key must never reside on VPS
findings.detail_md: The security-reviewer v2 report (FINDING-IRA-01) and operator-confirmed ADR-CAPTURE-001 both state: the OpenSSL CA key (`ca.key`) must reside on the operator's machine only. The VPS holds only `vps.crt` + `vps.key`. Violation of this rule defeats the IAM Roles Anywhere short-lived credential model.
findings.fix_recommendation: Issue VPS certificate from operator machine. SCP only `vps.crt` and `vps.key` to `/etc/dd-chain-capture/`. Never SCP `ca.key`.

findings.title: pipeline-restart-r1 is a hard blocker — must be ARCHIVED before implementation
findings.detail_md: `pipeline-restart-r1` is currently ACTIVE (phase: TASKS) in `specs/releases/ACTIVE.md`. `capture-decoupling-r5` cannot begin implementation until `pipeline-restart-r1` is fully closed (all tasks [x], CLOSURE.md written, archived). Overlapping write surfaces (ECS task definitions, capture layer) make concurrent implementation unsafe.
findings.fix_recommendation: Complete `pipeline-restart-r1` tasks, write CLOSURE.md, archive to `specs/_archive/releases/pipeline-restart-r1/`, update ACTIVE.md. Only then update ACTIVE.md to `release: capture-decoupling-r5 / phase: IMPLEMENTATION`.

findings.title: Devops-engineer v2 connector-init uses AvroFormat — incorrect
findings.detail_md: The devops-engineer v2 report's `connector-init` shell script uses `"format.class": "io.confluent.connect.s3.format.avro.AvroFormat"`. This would produce Avro binary files in S3, breaking Databricks Auto Loader which expects NDJSON. The correct value is `io.confluent.connect.s3.format.json.JsonFormat`.
findings.fix_recommendation: Use `JsonFormat` in all 3 connector JSON configs. Do NOT use the devops-engineer v2 connector-init script verbatim — override format.class.

contradictions_resolved.resolution: 3 connectors required (data-engineer v2 F-001 + critical finding #1)
Bronze UDF fix required before cutover (data-engineer v2 F-007)
contradictions_resolved.authority: data-engineer v2 F-007 supersedes grill-me conclusion

contradictions_resolved.resolution: FULL compatibility required (data-engineer v2 F-003 + critical finding #7)
JsonFormat required to produce NDJSON for Auto Loader

operator_decisions.decision: IAM Roles Anywhere with self-signed OpenSSL CA on operator machine
Memory-only (save='', appendonly=no). No AOF. No volume.
Round-robin + Redis SETNX. No DynamoDB access from VPS.
Amazon ECR, sa-east-1, same account. OIDC for CI.
Fix Bronze UDF (cloudFiles.format=json) before VPS cutover.
Kafka Connect S3 Sink (3 connectors). No boto3 direct write from jobs.
SSH tunnel only (no ports: mapping). Replace with Kafka UI (Provectus MIT) before PROD.
No ports: mapping for 9092. Internal Docker network only.
env_file: /etc/dd-chain-capture/aws.env. Never in environment: or secrets: blocks.
Bundled in Connect Docker image. Not bind-mounted.
Operator machine only. Never on VPS.
Minimum 8 GB RAM / 4 vCPU / 60 GB SSD. Recommended 16 GB / 8 vCPU.
